svg.text: AutoSE SDLC Workflow: Component Architecture View
Decoupled 6-Stage Agentic Pipeline · Sandboxed Adversarial Reviewer · Sovereign Human Governance

g.text: Links issue, spec, and test runs
Tools: git commit, push, gh pr

svg.text: Zero implementer memory · No transcript / chain-of-thought leak · Read-only files
Inputs: Issue Context + Git Diff (origin/main...HEAD) + Read-Only Repo
Security Invariant: Forbidden from git push, branch mutation, or merge
Violates ARCHITECTURE.md constraints -> Routes to Stage 2 (Max 2 rounds)
Syntax / logic bug, missing guard -> Routes to Stage 3 (Max 2 rounds)
100% verified -> Escalates to Human Maintainer for final merge decision

g.text: Complete Audit Package: spec.md, design.md, test_report.md, review.md
Sovereignty Invariant: Automated merge strictly prohibited (ADR-002, ADR-010)
Human maintainer retains exclusive right to approve PR and trigger release
